description: Catalog of swing report package items (#15723). 'render_defaults' are native_viewer_export options shared by every video; an item's 'args' add to or replace them; a composite 'needs' the items it is built from. 'default_package' is what a plain run produces; 'packages' are other named starting sets; a request file can include, exclude and override.
